static_review.real_communication: A separate owned thread calls captured REAL_POPEN.communicate on the real Popen instance; stdout_thread must be active before cancellation injection.
static_review.cancellation: The overridden caller-facing communicate raises a captured KeyboardInterrupt object; caught object identity and elapsed product cleanup are checked.
static_review.differential: The baseline is expected to leave live leaders running; the candidate must reap the leader; the already-exited case preserves returncode 23.
static_review.helper_observation: Helper PID comes from a file written by the receiver-launched helper in the receiver-owned case directory; a SYNCHRONIZE handle observes its liveness before and after product cleanup.
static_review.owned_cleanup: Finally restores subprocess.Popen, releases only each receiver-owned case by its release file, kills/reaps only the Popen leader created by this invocation, waits for its helper handle, joins the reader, then closes stdout only after that reader exits.
static_review.bounded_failure: Readiness, leader reap, helper wait and reader join are bounded. Owned leader/helper also have 15-second self-exit deadlines. Top-level receipt records refusal/failure and finishes on BaseException.
static_review.preservation: Production sources are read and hash-checked; no source file is modified. No external PID sweep, console-wide event, installed app, service or process-tree operation exists in the receiver.

execution_contract.python: Normal CPython execution with assertions enabled; do not use -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE.
execution_contract.root: A fresh receiver-owned directory containing the two exact source files; never reuse a prior case directory.

scope_limits: This is read-only source/fixture review and compilation, with no receiver execution by source_delivery.
The fixture qualifies a controlled exception while real Windows communication is active; it does not exercise hardware Ctrl-C or console signal propagation.
Any native pass must include the top-level receipt passed flag, all eight cases, final cleanup checks, and exact receiver/source hashes.
No installed TestPilot consumer, POSIX behavior, descendant-tree cleanup, or full-suite receiving is claimed.
